How We Cut Our Build Times in Half

Posted on March 2, 2024 by Jane Doe

Our CI pipeline used to take 42 minutes. That’s too long — developers were context-switching while waiting.

Step 1: Caching

We started by caching dependencies:

cache:
  key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}
  paths:
    - node_modules/

Step 2: Parallelism & Sharding

Tests were split into 8 shards.
Each shard runs in ~4 minutes.
The results:

StageBeforeAfter
Install9m1m
Test28m4m
Deploy5m5m

“Fast feedback is a feature.”

— Someone wise
